final: SELECT p.fundflux, AVG((ss.boxy - ss.boxx) / CAST(ss.boxx AS FLOAT)) as y_vs_x_avg, SUM(ss.aream2) / NULLIF(SUM(ss.volm3), 0) as area_to_vol, (SUM(ss.aream2) / NULLIF(SUM(ss.volm3), 0)) - (SELECT AVG(SUM(aream2) / NULLIF(SUM(volm3), 0)) FROM projects p2 JOIN scanspatial ss2 ON p2.arcregistry = ss2.arcref WHERE p2.fundflux IS NOT NULL AND ss2.boxx IS NOT NULL AND ss2.boxy IS NOT NULL AND ss2.volm3 IS NOT NULL AND ss2.aream2 IS NOT NULL AND ss2.boxx != 0 GROUP BY p2.fundflux) as above_average FROM projects p JOIN scanspatial ss ON p.arcregistry = ss.arcref WHERE p.fundflux IS NOT NULL AND ss.boxx IS NOT NULL AND ss.boxy IS NOT NULL AND ss.volm3 IS NOT NULL AND ss.aream2 IS NOT NULL AND ss.boxx != 0 GROUP BY p.fundflux HAVING (SUM(ss.aream2) / NULLIF(SUM(ss.volm3), 0)) > (SELECT AVG(SUM(aream2) / NULLIF(SUM(volm3), 0)) FROM projects p2 JOIN scanspatial ss2 ON p2.arcregistry = ss2.arcref WHERE p2.fundflux IS NOT NULL AND ss2.boxx IS NOT NULL AND ss2.boxy IS NOT NULL AND ss2.volm3 IS NOT NULL AND ss2.aream2 IS NOT NULL AND ss2.boxx != 0 GROUP BY p2.fundflux) ORDER BY area_to_vol DESC
